objective: Rules (R), helper (H) and agent (A) brains for each team role (B4 of the team workspace, 2026-11-24): the same written cases, invented data, tools, permissions and budgets, played through the real team runtime with a scripted person; scored by code from the records (main score, hard zeros, counts), with an optional free non-Claude judge that is advisory only. The winner of each role is chosen by team_arms_gate_v1, pinned by hash before any run.
rule: The cases are written by an independent session; the dev set is improved on, the sealed set is run once. No Claude model in any arm or judge. Every run is capped at 0.5 euro. A difference inside its bootstrap interval is noise. Nothing here says a team agent is ready for production.
known_limits: The team agents read invented fixtures only in this release (real tables come with T4a).
The person and the team members are scripted: a real person may answer differently or not at all.
The rules arm shows no plan of its own, so the judge's plan score favours the arms that write one.
